stanbax_faqs.question: How do I register my child for admission at Stanbax Schools?
stanbax_faqs.answer: Admissions can be initiated online via our admissions portal or by visiting the school administrative office. After submitting the application form, an entrance screening date is scheduled.

stanbax_faqs.question: What curriculum does Stanbax Schools follow?
stanbax_faqs.answer: We operate an enriched hybrid curriculum blending the Nigerian National Curriculum (NERDC) with British Cambridge curriculum frameworks to foster global competence and high academic standards.

stanbax_faqs.question: Are there flexible payment options for tuition fees?
stanbax_faqs.answer: Yes, Stanbax Schools offers structured installment payment options per term in arrangement with the school bursary department before term resumption.

stanbax_faqs.question: What safety and campus facilities are provided?
stanbax_faqs.answer: We maintain secure fenced school grounds, CCTV coverage, biometric/vetted access gates, round-the-clock trained security personnel, and a fully equipped staffed health clinic.

stanbax_faqs.question: What sports and clubs are available for students?
stanbax_faqs.answer: Students can participate in soccer, swimming, athletics, robotics, music, coding club, debate society, press club, and JETS science club.

stanbax_faq_header.title: Got Questions? We Have Answers
stanbax_faq_header.subtitle: Find comprehensive answers regarding admissions, curriculum, school schedule, tuition, and facilities at Stanbax Schools.

stanbax_cbt_exams.title: SS 2 Physics Termly Mock Assessment (WAEC/NECO Standard)
stanbax_cbt_exams.subject: Physics
stanbax_cbt_exams.instructions: Answer all 6 objective questions. Select the most accurate option. Calculators and periodic tables may be referenced.

questions.question: Which of the following is a scalar quantity?
questions.explanation: Electric potential has magnitude only and requires no directional vector, making it a scalar quantity.
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question: A body of mass 5 kg falls freely from a height of 20 m. Calculate its velocity just before hitting the ground (g = 10 m/s²).
questions.explanation: Using v² = u² + 2gh: v² = 0 + 2(10)(20) = 400. Therefore, v = √400 = 20 m/s.
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question: The unit of electrical capacitance in the SI system is named after which scientist?
questions.explanation: The SI unit of capacitance is the Farad (F), named in honour of Michael Faraday.
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question: A concave mirror has a focal length of 15 cm. Where will the real, inverted image of an object placed 30 cm from the mirror be formed?
options: At 30 cm (at the centre of curvature)
questions.explanation: When an object is placed at the centre of curvature (2f = 30 cm), its real inverted image is formed at the centre of curvature (30 cm).
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question: Which electromagnetic radiation has the shortest wavelength and highest frequency?
questions.explanation: Gamma rays occupy the highest frequency end (>10¹⁹ Hz) with the shortest sub-atomic wavelengths.
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question: The anomalous expansion of water occurs in the temperature interval between:
questions.explanation: Water contracts instead of expanding when heated from 0°C to 4°C, reaching its maximum density at 4°C.
questions.subject: Physics

stanbax_cbt_exams.title: BECE / Junior WAEC Mathematics Speed Drills
stanbax_cbt_exams.subject: Mathematics
stanbax_cbt_exams.instructions: Attempt all foundational questions within the allotted time limit.

questions.question: What is the sum of angles in a quadrilateral?
questions.explanation: The interior angles of any four-sided polygon sum to (4 - 2) * 180° = 360°.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.question: Find the prime factors of 42.
questions.explanation: 42 = 2 * 3 * 7, all of which are prime numbers.
questions.subject: Mathematics

stanbax_cbt_exams.title: JAMB UTME English Language Use of English & Lexis
stanbax_cbt_exams.subject: English Language
stanbax_cbt_exams.instructions: Choose the option that is most nearly opposite in meaning to the italicized word or best completes the syntactic pattern.

questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning: The doctor said the patient's condition was METEORIC in improvement.
questions.explanation: Meteoric denotes swift or sudden rise; its antonym is gradual or slow.
questions.subject: English Language

questions.question: Neither the class prefect nor the students _____ aware of the rescheduled assembly.
questions.explanation: In correlative conjunctions (neither... nor), the verb agrees with the nearer subject: "the students" (plural) takes "were".
questions.subject: English Language
